swimming_pool.evidence: The only pool is at the top right, on a neighboring lot. The central lot shows no blue water surface.

solar_panels.evidence: The central house roof is uniform gray shingle with no regular dark rectangular grid.

detached_structure.evidence: There is a small reddish-brown deck or addition attached to the east side of the house, and it appears attached rather than detached. A fenced garden plot sits to the north, but it is not a structure.

signals.notes: The central house has a driveway on the west side with two white vehicles parked in it. A fenced garden plot lies to the north, and dense mature tree canopy covers the east side of the lot, hiding much of the yard.
